$ agenthub modules
[exit 0]
--- stdout
  assistant    Muninn, an optional personal assistant: question reconciliation, channel leases
✓ backup       Nightly encrypted cloud backup + monthly restore test
  claude       Claude Code login check, updates, headless token expiry reminders
  codex        your Codex chats reach the mailbox by asking brunna's tools (no letters shown in the chat by themselves yet); brunna's own background work and decisions don't run on Codex yet (they need an LLM provider meanwhile)
  consolidate  Nightly: folds memory date files older than 14 days into reference/ (before the librarian) (needs an LLM: brunna llm setup)
  mirror       Nightly: updates the --mirror clone of every repo in mirror-list.txt
  owner        Built-in owner side: notices of new to-dos and questions (close and answer with brunna owner)
✓ reflect      Every Monday: the previous week's cross-project review (reflect/) (needs an LLM: brunna llm setup)
  sandbox      Platform-run capabilities (cap-runner): sandboxed projects borrow a capability with brunna cap-run --cap
  testcontainers Nightly: removes Docker containers labelled org.testcontainers that are more than a day old

Switch: brunna modules enable|disable <name> (changes modules in hub.json, then applies)
--- stderr

$ agenthub modules enable no-such-module
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
brunna modules: no module no-such-module (modules/ has: assistant, backup, claude, codex, consolidate, mirror, owner, reflect, sandbox, testcontainers)

$ agenthub modules enable mirror
[exit 0]
--- stdout
hub.json:modules.mirror = true
[agenthub config apply]
remember to commit hub.json (config as code).
--- stderr

$ agenthub modules disable backup
[exit 1]
--- stdout
hub.json:modules.backup = false
[agenthub config apply]
remember to commit hub.json (config as code).
--- stderr

=== hub.json modules
{"backup": false, "reflect": true, "mirror": true}
